$comment: Requirement block order, representation selection, and Scenario tags. This file is the machine-readable counterpart of openspec/specs/README.md.

blocks.label: Preconditions
blocks.purpose: Prior state, permissions, and existence conditions for referenced subjects required to apply the operation

blocks.label: Input and Acceptance
blocks.purpose: Input, permitted range, defaults, and acceptance or rejection conditions

blocks.label: Behavioral Rules
blocks.purpose: Decisions, calculations, state transitions, and externally observable output

blocks.label: Invariants
blocks.purpose: Conditions preserved before and after every permitted result of the operation

blocks.label: Side Effects
blocks.purpose: Changes and non-changes to related state, history, and notifications

blocks.label: Concurrency and Idempotency
blocks.purpose: Concurrent execution, retries, duplicates, and atomicity

blocks.label: Failure Handling
blocks.purpose: Failure results observable by the consumer and state preserved after failure

blocks.label: References
blocks.purpose: SSOT for an Interface, API, data definition, Policy, or external contract on which the Requirement depends

representations.name: Partition Table
representations.when: Acceptance or results differ by range in a continuous or ordered domain

representations.name: Decision Table
representations.when: Results differ by combinations of conditions

representations.name: State Transition Table
representations.when: A lifecycle state changes based on a trigger and optional guard

representations.name: Invariant
representations.when: A condition must always be maintained

representations.name: Scenario
representations.when: A concrete usage or verification example is required
